Fit a Model Unless It Is Already Good

Source: R/mxHelper-run.R
MxHelperRun.Rd

Fits the model with OpenMx::mxTryHard(), accepting status codes 0, 1, 5, and 6, unless it is already a good fit (MxHelperIsGoodFit()) with a positive definite Hessian (MxHelperHasPdHessian()). On an error, the input model is returned. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperRun(
  model,
  grad_tol = 0.01,
  ok_codes = 0L,
  require_finite_fit = TRUE,
  hess_tol_abs = 1e-08,
  hess_tol_rel = 1e-10,
  check_condition = FALSE,
  cond_max = 1e+12,
  silent = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

model

An OpenMx model (MxModel).

grad_tol

Positive number. Largest absolute gradient of a good fit.

ok_codes

Integer vector. OpenMx status codes accepted as converged.

require_finite_fit

Logical. If TRUE, a good fit needs a finite fit value.

hess_tol_abs

Positive number. Absolute tolerance on the smallest eigenvalue of the Hessian.

hess_tol_rel

Positive number. Tolerance on the smallest eigenvalue of the Hessian, relative to its largest absolute eigenvalue.

check_condition

Logical. If TRUE, the Hessian must also have a condition number of at most cond_max.

cond_max

Positive number. Largest condition number of the Hessian.

silent

Logical. If TRUE, suppress the progress output of OpenMx.

...

Further arguments to OpenMx::mxTryHard().

Value

Returns an OpenMx model. The internal version returns NULL when model is not an OpenMx model.

See also

Other Model Fitting Functions: MxHelperEnsureGoodHessian(), MxHelperForceHessianOptions(), MxHelperMuSigma(), MxHelperQuiet(), MxHelperReadRunSave(), MxHelperReadRunSaveNoHessian(), MxHelperRobustSE(), MxHelperRunNoHessian(), MxHelperStripHessian()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- data.frame(
  y1 = rnorm(n = 50),
  y2 = rnorm(n = 50)
)
fit <- MxHelperQuiet(
  expr = MxHelperMuSigma(
    x = x,
    extraTries = 2
  )
)
fit <- MxHelperRun(
  model = fit
)
fit$output$status$code
#> [1] 0
